quests.title: Demon Buster Basic Training 1
lines:
Try moving around your character
and the camera.
Once you feel comfortable
report back to Snakeman.

Register the Guard skill in Slot 5
of your Shortcut Table.
Once you are done
report back to Snakeman.

Use the Attack skill
to defeat 5 Slimes.
Once you are done
report back to Snakeman.

quests.title: Demon Buster Basic Training 2
lines:
Use the Guard skill in combat
and defeat 3 Gakis.
Once you are done
report back to Snakeman.

quests.title: Demon Buster Basic Training 3
lines:
Use the Rush skill to defeat
Will O'Wisps to collect
3 VB Training Cards then
hand them over to Snakeman.

quests.title: Demon Buster Basic Training 4
lines:
Learn Agi (Destruction Magic)
and then report back to Snakeman.

Cast Agi (Destruction Magic)
to defeat 1 Onmoraki.
Once you are done report back
to Snakeman.

quests.title: The Guard's Desire
lines:
<qdetail:qid_005_p01_01.dds>
Visit the Cathedral of Shadows
and ask the Master about demons.
Report back to the Guard.

<qdetail:qid_005_p03_01.dds>
Take the Guard's Letter
to the Home Point girl.

Set this spot as your Home Point.
Once you are done

quests.title: Fellow Adventurers
lines:
Form a party and then talk to
the Experienced Demon Buster.

Defeat the Hollow Beast Cerberus
and Garm in the Training Room.
Once you are done talk to 
the Experienced Demon Buster.

Report back to the Experienced
Demon Buster that you successfully
defeated the Hollow Beast Cerberus
and Garm.

Try right-clicking on another player
to get a handle on this function.

for any Trade Ticket other than A
report back to the Experienced DB.

Once you've traded Trade Ticket B
for any Trade Ticket other than B
report back to the Experienced DB.

for any Trade Ticket other than C
report back to the Experienced DB.

Once you've traded Trade Ticket D
for any Trade Ticket other than D
report back to the Experienced DB.

for any Trade Ticket other than E

quests.title: Gun Practice
lines:
Take a look at the RH Featherlight
and then talk to Mr. Hakamada.

Defeat 5 Cait Sith and then
report back to Mr. Hakamada.

quests.title: Close Counters
lines:
Place the Counter skill in your
Shortcut Table and then talk to the
Guard.

and then report back to the Guard.

quests.title: A Gentleman's Lesson

Table and then talk to the Dabster DB.

quests.title: Understanding Plasma
lines:
Acquire 20 Empty Cans: Oolong Tea
and 10 Wrinkled T-Shirts: Sweaty
by connecting with Plasma 
and then report back to DB Harumi.

quests.title: Extract the Aluminum!
lines:
Gather 10 Aluminums by deconstructing
Empty Cans: Oolong Tea and then
report back to DB Harumi.

quests.title: The Road to Smithing
lines:
Raise your Expertise
in Weapon Knowledge to Class 1
and then report your passion
to the Masterly Dwarf.

Learn the Blacksmith and Willow skills,
and then report back to the Masterly
Dwarf.

Gather 12 Bronzes, 8 Irons, 8 Cedars 
and 8 Whetstones and then 
report back to the Masterly Dwarf.

report back to the Masterly Dwarf.

quests.title: Smith Crown
lines:
Raise your Expertise
in Gun Knowledge to Class 1,
and then report your passion
to the Masterly Dwarf.

and then report back to the Masterly

8 Aluminums and 12 Oils and then 
report back to the Masterly Dwarf.

then report back to the Masterly Dwarf.

quests.title: The Ultimate Equipment
lines:
Take a look at the Slots in
the Dwarf's Machete and then 
report back to the Masterly Dwarf.

information listed in the Item Help
column in the Item Detail window of
the Dwarf's Medical Powder
and then talk to the Masterly Dwarf.

Use a Cabinet to modify 
the Dwarf's Machete
with the Dwarf's Medical Powder
and then talk to the Masterly Dwarf.

Modify the Dwarf's Machete
with the Dwarf's Iwakura Water and 
then talk to the Masterly Dwarf.

Modify the Dwarf's Machete
with the Dwarf's Revival Orb
and then talk to the Masterly Dwarf.

quests.title: A White Demon and a Mysterious Man and Woman
lines:
You have taken an investigation request from Naotura regarding the white demon and mysterious man and woman.
It seems they have been sighted in Shinjuku field.

You found White Demon Ose Hallel, but a Demon Buster was killed before your eyes.
Report to Naotura.

Have Asura tell you the details.

Investigate the strange outfits

Return to the Virtual Battle Room

quests.title: Act 2: The Missing Demon Buster
lines:
Investigate the disappearance of

Head for Souhonzan and relay the message
to DB Kureha.

Return to the Virtual Battle Room
and report back to Snakeman.

quests.title: Act 3: Curse of the Gods
lines:
Put a stop to DB Kisugi's hijacking
of the TMG Building Heliport.

Return to the Virtual Battle Room
and report back to Snakeman.

quests.title: Act 4: Sukunahikona
lines:
The Omoikane that suddenly appeared in
front of you has dropped a curse on you,
leaving behind only a vague message
about a seven-branched sword.

You remember the Omoikane that appeared
when you confronted DB Kisugi; could
there be a connection?

In any case, the first thing you should
do is gather information on your curse.

The old woman in the Shinjuku Babel
commercial area told you about your
curse and the Seven-Branched Sword.
It appears you can learn more about
both from the god Sukunahikona.

The first thing you will need to do is
gather information on Sukunahikona.

You asked Sukunahikona about your
curse just as he was leaving DB Kureha,
having repaired his gun and solved
his problems.

It appears the Omoikane placed the curse
on you in a desperate attempt to have
you find Sukunahikona and put a stop to
a horrific catastrophe that is about
to hit Tokyo.

Sukunahikona has ordered you to look
for the Seven-Branched Sword. DB Kureha,
meanwhile, has begun investigations
of his own.

For now, wait for Sukunahikona to
report back to you.

quests.title: Act 5: Search for the Seven-Branched Sword
lines:
According to Sukunahikona, he has
a vague idea of where to find
the Seven-Branched Sword.

Head to Shibuya as ordered, and
follow Sukunahikona's instructions.

The Seven-Branched Sword is apparently
somewhere in the Shibuya Underpass.
However, Sukunahikona was unable to
enter the location, as a ward has
been placed upon the entrance.

First, look for the Shibuya Underpass
entrance.

Having talked to the Guard at the
Shibuya Underpass entrance, it has
become clear that you will need
permission from General Yamamoto
to enter.

Head for General Yamamoto to seek
permission to enter the Shibuya
Underpass.

You now have permission to enter the
Shibuya Underpass. The entrance had
apparently been sealed off due to it
being full of the miasma emitted by
a curse god who lives in there.

Head for the Shibuya Underpass to
obtain the Seven-Branched Sword.

Sukunahikona has somehow managed to
enter the Shibuya Underpass as well.

Just as you were warned, the place is
full of noxious miasma. Defeat the
source of this miasma, the curse god,
before you run out of health.

You defeated the Take-Mikazuchi who
had become a curse god and managed
to find the Seven-Branched Sword;
but someone had already destroyed it.

Just as you were puzzling over what
to do, Sukunahikona and Omoikane
appeared and ordered you to seek out
the blades of the sword that have
been scattered across Tokyo.

How big a catastrophe is this going
to be, to be able to bring together
even Heavenly Gods and Nation Rulers?

quests.title: Act 6: The Mysterious Girl
lines:
You found the Seven-Branched Sword in
the Shibuya Underpass, but someone
had already destroyed it.

Look for the sword's blades that
have been scattered across Tokyo,
using the sword's light as a guide.

You found the Seven-Branched Sword in
the Shibuya Underpass, but someone
had already destroyed it.

Look for the sword's branches that
have been scattered across Tokyo,
using the sword's light as a guide.

As you picked up the blade in the
TMG Building in your quest to find
the missing blades of the Seven-
Branched Sword, a mysterious girl
came up to speak to you.

Is she a Demon Buster? She knew your
name, although you had never met her
before.

In any case, you should now look for
the final blade of the sword.

Just when you thought you had found
the final blade of the sword, the
mysterious girl snatched it away from
you. It appears there is someone who
does not want you to have the Seven-
Branched Sword...

quests.title: Act.8　Sting Operation
lines: Investigate the evil.

You gathered information from the residents.

quests.title: Act.9　The Mysterious Sand
lines: Report to Snakeman about DB Miruwa's betrayal.

Snakeman's information points to Kekka in Shinjuku Babel.
Watch her movements carefully.

quests.title: Act.10 Song of Blood

Defeat the demons she summoned and follow her.
Report to Snakeman about Kekka.
